title: An adaptable and personalized framework for top-N course recommendations in online learning
reason: Deep-reinforcement-learning course recommender evaluated on a public Coursera course-review dataset by hit rate, NDCG, recall and precision. No indicator is related to learning success or a personality-related construct; population is anonymous MOOC reviewers.

extraction.design: algorithm development and offline evaluation on secondary data
extraction.population: Coursera course reviewers (100K review dataset); not identifiable as HE students
extraction.lms_indicators: course ratings and review text (sentiment) from a MOOC dataset
extraction.notes: Learning style is named as a model factor but not measured or related to anything. Secondary: E3 doubtful (population unknown).
